mechanism: 고소득 가계 지출 감소의 변화가 판매량·단가·판매시장 접근성 경로를 통해 매출액의 감소로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R09186의 적용 맥락: This paper analyzes the economic impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States from January 2019 through December 2021, emphasizing the March–April 2020 shock and subsequent recovery. It uses high-frequency, ZIP-code- and county-level private-sector transaction, payroll, job-posting, small-business revenue, and mobility data. Units include households (proxied by ZIP median income), small businesses, and workers across industries and wage quartiles. The institutional setting features pandemic health risks, state shutdowns/reopenings, federal fiscal responses (CARES/stimulus payments in April 2020, Jan and March 2021), expanded UI, and PPP loans.
